LA MAISON – HOLISTIC PROPERTIES GROUP is pleased to present this stunning property, ideally located in the heart of a highly sought-after residential area, combining greenery with immediate proximity to Stockel, public transport, and numerous amenities.
Upon entering, the tone is immediately set: an entrance hall with vestibule, cloakroom, and guest toilets reflects space, functionality, and comfort.
The ground floor offers elegant reception rooms, including a spacious living room, a large central hallway, a dining room, and a separate kitchen.
These living spaces open directly onto a pleasant terrace, extending into a beautiful garden, creating a green and privileged living environment, ideal for relaxation and entertaining.
Adjacent to the kitchen, a corridor with built-in storage provides additional practicality and ensures smooth circulation throughout the house.
The first floor hosts the night area with three comfortable bedrooms. The master suite benefits from its own dressing room, en-suite bathroom, and separate toilet, offering a private and refined living space. The two additional bedrooms share a separate bathroom.
The top floor, set under the roof, offers two further bedrooms, ideal as children’s rooms, a home office, guest rooms, or leisure spaces.
In total, the property offers 5 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, with a highly functional layout and excellent potential. The cellars and garage complete this property.
Renovation work is to be expected, offering an excellent opportunity to reimagine the spaces and fully enhance the property’s potential.
A prime address, an exceptional location, and strong potential: a rare opportunity for those seeking a family home to personalize to their taste.
